item.title: Murph counts your game day in one message
item.summary: Tell Murph what you did, like "read my chapter tonight", and it posts that for the day without asking what the post should say.
item.details: After midnight, "yesterday" and "last night" now count the evening that just ended, since a game day runs until 3 AM. Turning a game reminder off now just turns it off, instead of asking you to switch on notifications. Group game progress no longer shows a day you marked not done as posted. Evening check-ins keep coming while you post in the app, even if you don't text back.
